pages.caption: the laundry room stencil, cut from a list of the ship's equipment.
PROVIZION STORY — meant to say "provision store": the food storeroom.
the provision store stencil, cut from a crew list from damietta, egypt, 2022.
ELECTRIK STORE — the electrical spare-parts storeroom. "electric" is misspelled.
the ELECTRIK STORE stencil, cut from an invoice.
DOMESTIC WASTES — where kitchen and cabin garbage is kept until port.
ПЛАСТИК — "plastic": the bin for plastic waste. the stencil.
another waste stencil, cut from a bill of lading.
CARGO RESIDUALS — the bin for what's left of the cargo after unloading.
the cargo residuals stencil, with "PLASTIC" written in pencil.
ТАКЕЛАЖНЫЙ НАБОР — "rigging kit": the store for ropes, shackles and hooks.
the rigging kit stencil, cut from the list of the ship's certificates.
